tasks.title: Connect criteria to explicit implementation checks and honest results
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: Existing accepted criteria reach task/component/artifact/check and actual evidence through explicit mappings; lexical file co-occurrence stays discovered association, changed-file lists stay provenance, missing/currentness facts remain explicit. Bookkeeping/result references cannot self-invalidate native evidence.
tasks.validation: Existing graph/plan/native evidence fixtures exercise explicit mappings, unresolved references, lexical false coverage, actual report digests/status/applicability and semantic versus status/result identity. Demonstrate at least one real RM-08 criterion using current evidence.
